# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.6 D3 colonisation framework, phase 3 (the Black Sea trading posts). Generated by gen_colonization.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# The Roman emporion: a trading post of the empire on another country's soil (decision 209). NOT vanilla's trade_office.
# Who may build: location_potential reads the list oe_col_admitted kept on the location (the countries its owner admitted),
# written as vanilla's trade_company_buildings.txt reads its own list. The list is filled by oe_col.21 after the host's
# event oe_col.24 (effect oe_col_post_open); the script then builds the house at once. remove_if takes it down as soon
# as its owner is struck off the list (a post seized, closed or lost): see oe_col_post_drop.
# One level: a "chartered quarter" (level 2 in the books) is the location modifier oe_col_emporion_fort, not a second
# level, so that it cannot be had from the building panel. Yields: a little merchant capacity and power for its owner in
# the site's market, and the site draws settlers (design 3.5.1's "Roman emporion" modifier lives here).
oe_col_emporion = {
	is_foreign = yes
	# r20 (2026-11-20): the engine refuses a foreign building that has none of need_good_relation,
	# stronger_power_projection, own_or_overlord_relation_needed, international_organization_link
	# (load error building_type.cpp:2677). Good relations fit the design: the host has admitted us.
	need_good_relation = yes
	stronger_power_projection = no
	max_levels = 1
	pop_type = burghers
	category = trade_category
	employment_size = foreign_trade_employment
	pop_size_created = foreign_trade_employment
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	forbidden_for_estates = yes
	build_time = trade_post_build_time
	can_destroy = { always = no }
	country_potential = { oe_col_post_builder = yes }
	location_potential = {
		has_variable_list = oe_col_admitted
		is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_col_admitted target = scope:actor }
	}
	allow = {
		has_variable_list = oe_col_admitted
		is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_col_admitted target = scope:actor }
		has_owner = yes
		owner ?= { NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor } }
	}
	remove_if = {
		location = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_list = oe_col_admitted }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_col_admitted target = root.owner } }
			}
		}
	}
	unique_production_methods = {
		oe_col_emporion_upkeep = {
			icon_type = building_type
			icon = trade_office
			paper = 0.05
			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}
	modifier = {
		merchant_capacity_from_building = 0.2
		merchant_power_from_building = 0.2
		local_migration_attraction = 0.1
	}
}
